title: Service Properties Trust Receives Statement of Support from Shareholder Flat Footed LLC
summary: NEWTON, Mass., November 13, 2026--Service Properties Trust (Nasdaq: SVC) ("SVC" or the "Company") today announced that Flat Footed LLC ("Flat Footed"), an SVC institutional shareholder, has expressed support for the plan announced earlier today by SVC’s Board of Trustees to transition SVC into a pure-play triple net lease REIT.

title: Service Properties Trust Receives Statement of Support from Shareholder Helix Partners Management LP
summary: NEWTON, Mass., November 13, 2026--Service Properties Trust (Nasdaq: SVC) ("SVC" or the "Company") today announced that Helix Partners Management LP ("Helix Partners"), SVC’s largest institutional shareholder, has issued a letter to SVC’s Board of Trustees (the "Board") in support of the plan SVC’s Board has announced to transition SVC into a pure-play triple net lease REIT.
